what: UNISIM-IV-2026 (UNICAMP), a public benchmark of a pre-salt-like carbonate reservoir with CO2-rich light oil and WAG injection. Only the porosity and rock-type grids are read here; this file and porosity-histogram.json are a DERIVED database, published under the ODbL like their source.
license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 with the Database Contents License; any publication must name the benchmark.

read.rule: a cell is active when POR > 1e-6 and RTYPE > 0 (inactive cells carry 1.2345e-12)
read.relperm: Swi = 0.18 and Sorg = 0.35 in the stromatolite and coquina tables (KR_est_1_5.inc, KR_coq_1.inc): the largest mobile gas saturation is 1 - 0.18 - 0.35 = 0.47
read.state: REFPRES 62000 kPa at REFDEPTH 5300 m (UNISIM-IV-2026_Base_Case.dat); ZGAS CO2 0.4392 (the injected gas is 44% CO2)
